acceptance_predicates.description: A bounded real OpenRouter request is attempted with an operator-supplied runtime key and its outcome is truthful and typed.
Selected-agent and all-agent live benchmark modes are exercised with reviewed provider/model configuration.
Missing/malformed key, timeout, transport, non-2xx, unavailable-model, and process failures are typed and nonzero.
Explicit live failures never invoke mock or offline replay paths.
Key, prompt, raw response, cassette bytes, and private paths are absent from receipts, logs, and state.
Human-default and explicit --json result contracts agree on mode, provider/model identity, and typed outcome.

definition_of_done: Credential-backed positive and complete credential-free negative matrix pass at exact ASB main.
Exact paired frontend references and privacy-safe receipt are independently reviewed.

gates.description: Credential-backed positive and credential-free negative live outcomes are typed.
No credential or raw response material enters evidence.
